label: model output
about: A two-sentence summary of the flight picture for 2026-11-12 04:00-04:59 UTC, written by an open-weight model (meta-llama/llama-4-maverick) through OpenRouter from the JSON in input, and published only because every number in it is one of the input's numbers and it is two sentences (check). Model output: not checked for meaning beyond that, and not ours. The data itself: snapshots/ and crosswind.json.
not_a_warning_service: Not a warning service. No forecast or advice of ours. Your airline decides whether your flight runs: its site or app has the latest. For warnings follow IPMA and ANEPC.
attribution: Aircraft positions: adsb.lol (https://adsb.lol), community ADS-B data, licensed under the Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0 (https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/). Our snapshots are a derived database offered under the same licence.
text: Near Lisbon, 5 distinct TAP Air Portugal flights were seen in one hour, with 1 aircraft airborne and 1 on the ground at 04:50. At 04:30, the wind was blowing at 11 knots from 270 degrees at Lisbon airport and at 4 knots from 280 degrees at Funchal airport.

model.via: OpenRouter, through tools/llm.mjs (one ledger line per call)
